description:
*“I have erectile dysfunction.”*

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

 *“Then why don’t we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you.”* 

Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what’s happening, he’s suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon’s “scientific experiment.” What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20? Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn’t physical after all… 

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)
